headline: Entering the Luxury Suite

result.label: A new hospitality growth channel
result.note: Direction only — the client publishes “a sharp uptick”

summary: A consumer-market leader stuck outside hospitality, where buyers are budget-first. We positioned it in luxury venues with designer proof — and hospitality sales took a sharp uptick, opening VRBO and cruise-line markets.

question.h: Dominant at retail, invisible in hospitality.
question.p: simplehuman dominates the consumer market with its sleek stainless steel mirrors and trash cans. But breaking into hospitality was tougher: the purchase process is complex, the competition cheaper, and design differentiation harder to prove to budget conscious buyers.

made.p: We positioned simplehuman where it belonged — in the world’s finest hotels, restaurants, and resorts — leveraging designer testimonials and a multi-channel campaign including a B2B website, tradeshow and support materials, eblasts, activations and PR that highlighted durability, functionality, and elevated guest satisfaction. We also opened new markets with VRBO and cruise lines.

happened.h: A sharp uptick, and a new channel.
happened.p: The result: a sharp uptick in hospitality sales and a new growth channel for the brand.

rationale: Word-stat only (“Sales ↑”). This is the case that proves the agency sells into B2B, not just consumer.
